name: Emergency stop
trigger: Any emergency stop device is pressed
reaction: Stop category 1: controlled braking, then torque removed (SS1 then STO)
safe_state: All joints at standstill, torque off, brakes applied

name: Power and force limiting (PFL)
trigger: Measured contact force or joint torque exceeds the configured limit
reaction: Protective stop, then the arm can be pushed away by hand

name: Safely limited speed (SLS)
trigger: Tool centre point speed exceeds the configured limit

name: Safely limited position (SLP)
trigger: A monitored point of the arm approaches a configured safety plane
reaction: Protective stop before the plane is crossed

name: Safe standstill and prevention of unexpected start-up
trigger: Robot is paused and any joint moves beyond the standstill tolerance

name: Enabling device in manual mode
trigger: Three-position enabling device is released or pressed fully

name: Safe brake control and brake test
trigger: Torque is removed or power is lost; cyclic brake test fails
reaction: Brakes applied on all joints; operation blocked after a failed test
